entities.summary: Daniel Zaar is a Swedish professional ice hockey winger currently playing with Rögle BK in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Zaar was drafted in the sixth round, 152nd overall, in the 2012 NHL entry draft by the Columbus Blue Jackets.
